name: AVES 2
notes: Eyrie hub: 175 RR games (RR grid; rounds from the organiser's schedule sheet), 30 DE and 15 SE (places 17-32, stage consolation) games, all re-derived from per-question scoresheets (game pages) -> team_game_subjects, player_game_stats, player stats with full names from the player pages. Scope rr reproduces the site's player pages exactly (gp/tuh from halves played); scope playoff from DE/SE scoresheets (TUH only when the roster had <=4 players). BISV 3 withdrew (5 unplayed games, team omitted); State College Area 2 (no players, 0 points) games and three 1-tossup games (incl. WB final and grand final, The Frazer School 1 champion) are flagged forfeit. No energy category in this set.
